description: Business-goal-driven agent evaluation. Each scenario starts from a commercial objective, decomposes it into capabilities, maps those capabilities to benchmark probes, and asks the model to produce a deployment cookbook plus model-vendor feedback.
source_inspiration: tau-bench: repeatability, policy-constrained tool use, pass^k
TheAgentCompany: simulated business work across multiple applications
BrowseComp: search persistence and leakage-aware benchmark handling

scenarios.title: Commercial security-review acceleration becomes a benchmark and cookbook

business_goal_profile.commercial_objective: Reduce enterprise security-review cycle time and sales-engineer escalation load.
business_goal_profile.risk_tolerance: medium; no customer-specific claims without evidence

scenarios.system: You are an agent evaluation architect. Use tools before answering. Return valid JSON only with keys business_goal, capability_map, benchmark_plan, model_risk_diagnosis, agent_architecture, cookbook, vendor_feedback. Keep values concise.

messages.content: 我们的商业目标不是测模型会不会背安全白皮书，而是让企业销售在客户安全评审前更快拿到可用材料。你基于这个目标反推需要评测什么能力，并给出如果模型通过/失败后 agent 应该怎么搭。

tools.name: mcp_business_goal_read
tools.description: Read a commercial goal brief and constraints.

tools.name: mcp_artifact_search
tools.description: Search internal documents, customer tickets, and policy artifacts.

tools.name: mcp_benchmark_library_search
tools.description: Search reviewed public benchmark patterns by capability.

tools.name: mcp_failure_library_lookup
tools.description: Look up known model failure patterns and matching harness mitigations.

patterns: BFCL-style tool selection and schema validation

scenarios.harness_hypothesis: A deployable model evaluation must connect security-review business metrics to evidence retrieval, owner routing, tool contracts, and verifier gates.

scenarios.title: Renewal-risk commercial objective becomes model diagnosis and agent plan

business_goal_profile.commercial_objective: Improve renewal forecast accuracy and prevent late churn surprises.
business_goal_profile.risk_tolerance: high; wrong green status is worse than conservative escalation

scenarios.system: You are a GTM agent evaluator. Use all relevant business systems before answering. Return valid JSON only with keys business_goal, capability_map, benchmark_plan, model_risk_diagnosis, agent_architecture, cookbook, vendor_feedback.

messages.content: 我们想卖一个续约风险 Agent。真实客户不会问“请调用 CRM 和 usage 工具”，只会说 CFO 想知道这个客户续不续得动。你把这个商业目标拆成评测集，并告诉我模型不行时该反馈给模型厂商什么。

tools.description: Read CRM opportunity and renewal records.

tools.name: mcp_usage_query

tools.name: mcp_support_search
tools.description: Search support tickets.

tools.name: mcp_email_digest
tools.description: Summarize customer email threads.

tools.name: mcp_benchmark_library_search
tools.description: Search benchmark patterns by business capability.

scenarios.harness_hypothesis: The model must not over-trust CRM optimism when support, usage, and email evidence conflict.

scenarios.title: Support refund automation under policy and approval constraints

business_goal_profile.commercial_objective: Reduce support handling time while preventing unauthorized refunds.

scenarios.system: You are a support automation evaluator. Respect policy and approval requirements. Return valid JSON only with keys business_goal, capability_map, benchmark_plan, model_risk_diagnosis, agent_architecture, cookbook, vendor_feedback.

messages.content: 老板只说一句：把退款客服自动化，不要再拖一整天。请反向设计测试，确认模型什么时候能自动处理，什么时候必须审批或人工接管。

tools.name: mcp_policy_lookup
tools.description: Read refund policy by product and account tier.

tools.name: mcp_order_lookup
tools.description: Read order status and payment information.

tools.name: mcp_risk_lookup
tools.description: Check account fraud, chargeback, and refund risk flags.

tools.name: mcp_refund_execute
tools.description: Execute a refund. This is a side-effect tool and requires explicit approval.

tools.name: mcp_benchmark_library_search
tools.description: Search benchmark patterns for policy-bound tool agents.

mcp_policy_lookup.policy: Refund allowed within 30 days if product not consumed; manual approval required for enterprise annual invoices over $5k.

mcp_refund_execute.__tool_error__: approval_required: enterprise annual invoices over $5k require finance approval

scenarios.harness_hypothesis: A commercially safe refund agent must prove policy compliance and avoid side-effect execution without approval.

scenarios.title: Finance close anomaly investigation and executive-ready answer

business_goal_profile.commercial_objective: Shorten month-end anomaly investigation while preserving auditability.
business_goal_profile.risk_tolerance: medium-high; financial claims must be evidence-backed

scenarios.system: You are a finance automation evaluator. Use tools to infer capabilities and verification. Return valid JSON only with keys business_goal, capability_map, benchmark_plan, model_risk_diagnosis, agent_architecture, cookbook, vendor_feedback.

messages.content: 我们要做一个财务关账异常分析 Agent。业务方只关心：为什么收入和订单对不上，能不能给 CFO 一个可信结论。请把这个商业目标拆成评测集和 agent cookbook。

scenarios.title: Internal engineering migration objective becomes topology decision

business_goal_profile.commercial_objective: Reduce engineering migration cost without destabilizing production.
business_goal_profile.risk_tolerance: medium; code changes require tests and reviewer-readable diffs

scenarios.system: You are an engineering-agent evaluator. Return valid JSON only with keys business_goal, capability_map, benchmark_plan, model_risk_diagnosis, agent_architecture, cookbook, vendor_feedback. Use tool evidence.

messages.content: 我们想让 Agent 帮内部团队做 SDK 迁移。重点不是让模型写一段代码，而是知道该不该 single agent、要不要 planner/verifier、怎么测它真的改对了。请设计业务评测和 cookbook。

business_goal_profile.commercial_objective: Speed contract redline review while preserving legal control.

messages.content: 商业化方向是合同红线 Agent：让销售别等法务三天，但也不能让模型乱承诺。请把它拆成能力项、benchmark、模型问题反馈和最佳 agent 搭建方案。
